justification: The charity is recognised as a charity for tax purposes (E02), the donation is from an individual (Elaine Carter) made via direct bank transfer (not payroll giving, not for goods or services, not a share or voucher) (E09, E10, E12, E13), the donor has paid sufficient tax (Income Tax of £980 in 2025–26, which is more than the £80 claimed in total, satisfying E04/E07), and the donor has made a Gift Aid declaration (E05/E06). The donation was not in exchange for a benefit or goods/services (E11), and is not covered by any of the prohibited types (E09–E13). Therefore, Gift Aid is eligible for this donation (E01).
